platforms.name: Mobile
platforms.detailedDescription: Developed for the technology giant Intelbras, Programador CIE is a mobile application focused on industrial hardware communication. It serves as a field engineering tool for technicians installing addressable fire alarm systems (CIE 1125, 1250, and 2500). The primary architectural challenge was building a 100% offline system capable of managing a massive and complex state tree (zones, devices, loops, and automation rules across multiple panels). All configuration is parameterized on the mobile device and exported directly into a custom file format (.cie), which the technician seamlessly installs via a physical USB connection into the alarm panel on-site.
learnings: Deep Mobile File System Manipulation (I/O): Mastered native reading, parsing, and writing of physical files using RNFS, ensuring the final generated JSON was perfectly formatted and validated for external hardware integration.

Massive Offline State Architecture: Orchestrated a massive in-memory state tree using Redux and Redux-Saga without performance degradation, managing complex states where persistence relied entirely on physical file generation rather than standard local databases.

Translating Hardware Logic to UI/UX: Converted strict security engineering rules (panel interconnection, dual-input, and delayed-output conditions) into intuitive, reactive mobile forms with robust asynchronous validation (Formik/Yup).

Mission-Critical Enterprise Integration: High-responsibility software engineering applied to the industrial sector, guaranteeing absolute data integrity vital for the operation of large-scale fire prevention systems.
